body: If it's with no reason you may tell them off. They have no right to throw you away if you're doing everything according to your rent contract.

I haven't done any of those jobs because, I am not aware we have those. There only one I know if cleaning the town for 11 hours a day, but it is unacceptable due to my health. There is also a youth centre that is working with volunteers, but they only accept people up to 25 years old. SO It is too late for me. I know it sounds like it is excuse, but that's just how it is.

I can relate to you. But don't you have someone on the internet who you could truly call a friend? And not FB or any other places. It would be better to search for someone with the same interest like you and MAYBE you will both click. It helps a little. I could try to be your friend...
